thread:
Anya (Sales): FYI Acme wants to kick off a 2-week POC. They asked for our SOC 2 report, an NDA, and a short 'bridge' attestation while the report is finalized. Can legal/security confirm what we can share fast?
Michael (Legal): We can turn around a mutual NDA same day if you give contact + billing info. Bridge attestation: we can draft interim language but must be explicit it's not a completed SOC 2 Type II.
Lisa (Security): We typically share a controls matrix + scoped readiness summary under NDA. Bridge letters OK if timeboxed (30 days) and limited to staging/sandbox access. What controls do they care about specifically?
Anya (Sales): They listed: encryption at rest, KMS, SSO (Okta), and logs/retention. Contact is julia.t@acmecorp.com. They want a sandbox with synthetic data.
Michael (Legal): Drafting NDA + bridge. Proposed bridge snippet: 
```"This interim attestation certifies that as of <date> Redwood Inference maintains the administrative, technical, and physical controls described in the attached controls matrix. This attestation is interim and not a substitute for a SOC 2 Type II report."```
Michael (Legal): Also adding: access limited to non-production sandbox, no export of customer PII, expires 30 days unless extended in writing.
Lisa (Security): Controls summary we can share under NDA: AES-256 at rest, AWS KMS w/ customer CMKs supported, Okta SSO (OIDC+SCIM), centralized audit logs (90d retention). For POC tenants default retention 7d; can tighten. We'll provide a short FAQ for reviewers.
Ben (SRE): We can provision an isolated tenant with egress controls and export disabled. ProvisionBot will queue once NDA is signed. I'll prepare a runbook for access and key restrictions.
Anya (Sales): Great. Michael 3 I'll need the NDA + bridge by EOD to send to Acme.
Michael (Legal): On it. I'll upload a draft and paste the link here when ready. Note: if they request auditor pages/excerpts from the final report, escalate to legal — we can't share audit firm deliverables without approval.
Lisa (Security): Internal links for reference: https://redwood-internal/docs/security/soc2-readiness-2026Q1 and the controls matrix snippet:
```- Encryption at rest: AES-256 (AWS KMS)
- Key management: Customer CMK supported
- Auth: Okta SSO (OIDC + SCIM)
- Logging: Centralized logs, 90-day retention (POC defaults 7 days)
- Sandbox export: disabled by policy for POCs```
Anya (Sales): Contact info added; I'll request the NDA signature and confirm sandbox requirements.
ProvisionBot: New sandbox request created (req-9921) - pending NDA verification.
Anya (Sales): Acme asked for explicit clause that PII cannot be exported from the sandbox. Michael: can add export prohibition. Lisa: can you confirm enforcement?
Lisa (Security): Confirmed. Export blocked at tenant level; we'll enable redaction and monitor logs.
Ben (SRE): I'll tag the provisioning ticket with export-block and retention=7d.
Michael (Legal): NDA + interim bridge uploaded: https://redwood-internal/legal/ndas/2026/acme-temp-bridge.docx (internal). Sending to julia.t now.
Anya (Sales): Sent to Acme; pinged for signature. Will update thread when signed. :thumbsup:
Anya (Sales): Quick note for the team: if they ask for vendor risk portal access (SIG), we'll provide a limited SIG/CAIQ under NDA or via our security portal; Lisa, prefer sharing link or static export?
Lisa (Security): Prefer portal link (time-limited access) or static SIG export under NDA. Portal is faster and we can revoke after POC.
Anya (Sales): OK, will offer portal link first. Thanks everyone!
